## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — behavior-preserving restructure
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` / `perf` — maintenance, pipelines, performance

## Description

<!-- What changed and why. Link the issue: "Closes #123". -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests written **first** (TDD: RED → GREEN → refactor) and passing
- [ ] Coverage gate met (80%+; safety-critical paths specified by tests before implementation)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, keys, tokens, or credentials (env/keyring only)
- [ ] No personal, conversational, or health-adjacent data included in code, fixtures, or logs
- [ ] All user input validated at the boundary
- [ ] Commit messages follow the conventional-commits format
- [ ] Documentation updated where behavior or scope changed
- [ ] I have read and follow CONTRIBUTING.md and the Code of Conduct
